### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set / public surface: no `packages/**` path is touched; nothing published changes. **Right** — `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` match the diff.
- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`: additive exports only (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HOLD_KEY`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HOLD_TEMPLATE`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HOLD_LIST_HOURS`, `readContractReviewHold`, `contractReviewHold`); `contractReviewHandoff` / `contractReviewClaims` bodies untouched; the `self-test-reads` declaration stays on L77 and only its rationale text changes. **Right** — internal PM tooling, off the governed register (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` rows: `.claude/**` is `claude-tree` Tier S in objectstack; no `scripts/pm` row), as the claim's correction of the card's 「Tier H」 says.
- `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`: `--json` rows gain a `hold` object (additive); the status vocabulary stays `TAKE,WAIT,HELD,DONE` (pinned); trigger (b) alone yields to a live hold; a live overdue or untimed hold on a WAIT row is listed. `git grep` on the head finds no in-repo consumer of `--json` and exactly one consumer of the three sibling readers (this file, L242–244). **Right.**
- Gate surface: the live reader is not wired into any workflow (`.github/workflows` names only the self-test via `check:pm-record-recognisers`); report-only, exit 0. No new check-run, workflow step or half-state row. **Right** — the card's 「新增门禁默认否」 holds, and contract-review.md L60 (「无 check、workflow 或队列守卫读…hold 行」) is true of the tree.
- Governed text, line for line — triage-duties.md: L9 adds 「hold 行」 to what the review step reads (**right**, the reader does read it); L26 reads every `main` push, schedule and queue conclusion since the previous round record (**right**, card item 1); L27 anchors unanchored window reds p0, green-again included, and records a gap over 90 minutes (**right against the card's words; see ④ should-fix 1 for its breadth**); L60 answers `pm:retriage` on `pm:epic` cards at once, parents still never dispatched (**right**, card item 2). contract-review.md: L29 template, L30 per-head clearing / (b) does not fire / lane ends it with label or hand-off, L31 24-hour listing (**right**, card item 3 verbatim); L33, L49 fold restatements (**right**, see ③); L60 adds 「/hold」 (**right**).
- Folds, each checked at its claimed home on `origin/main`: old triage-duties L3 → SKILL.md L86 row (reader and timing present; the 「全部职责」 bound has no home — ④ should-fix 2); 「涉 cloud 整卡归 cloud 车道」 → SKILL.md L165 and cross-repo-coordination.md L44, both 「涉 cloud 即整卡归 cloud PM」 (**present**); 「(申报面外三面加 ④)」 → contract-review.md L39 and L41 (**present**); the isolated reviewer's scratch rule → `--brief-template` ⛔ block (confirmed in this review's own brief: 「Scratch space is … alone; nothing there you did not write this round is read」) pinned by self-test L2529, kept by L44 (**present**); 「判据机读已提交树」 → contract-review.md L17 and triage-duties.md L11 (**present**).
- 「父单是协调节点」: zero hits under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch` on `origin/main`; nearest are triage-duties L60 「父单永不派发」 and filing-gate L16 「④ 协调节点」. Item 2 riding L60 is **right**.

### ② Semver level

No package touched; `skip-changeset` label present; Check Changeset `success`. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the claim; no changeset is owed and none is written. **Matches.** The declared face is none; the tier here comes from the two governed paths (rules face), not from the Clause-② line.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none. Dev deviations, each answered:
1. Ablation not run (os-dev.md forbids ablating a script) — **accepted**: the pin case 「⭐ a live hold on the current head holds (b)…」 carries its control leg in-case (same row reads TAKE with no hold, WAIT with one); removing the `hold.state !== 'live'` guard reds it.
2. Stale role definition at the shared checkout — **no bearing on the committed tree**.
3. AGENTS.md 「assignee mirrors the card's」 vs os-dev.md L37/L60 — **outside this PR's surface; drift between two governed texts, carrier named in the report. Escalated to the seat as a note, not a finding here.** PR has no assignees, as os-dev.md and the order say.
4. 「One line each」 taken as two lines (item 1) and three (item 3) — **accepted**: the card's acceptance is 「each states its rule once」, which holds; both files sit at their ceilings (60/60, 102/102 measured; changed lines 96–119 B; the one 122 B line, contract-review L22, is pre-existing on `main`).
5. Item 2 on L60 not L75 — **confirmed** (see ①); L75 governs the stale-premise re-check, state-machine.md L40 governs `pm:retriage` answering.
6. 24-hour clause in contract-review.md — **right**: the card places all of item 3 there, and the recogniser's `self-test-reads` declaration (dispatch-gates census) may read only project-forms.md and contract-review.md.
7. Recogniser consumers — **confirmed** by `git grep` on the head: one consumer, `check-owed-reviews.mjs`.

9. Hypothesis 3 — informational.
Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no relay note owed. Conflict of interest: the card was filed by the triage seat and this PR changes triage's rules; the review was rendered by an isolated subagent that did not draft the card, fed the card, PR and check-runs only.

### ④ Design judgment

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`** — held against card #27370 items 1–2, ruling #27047 items 5–6, landing-operations.md 约定①–③ and SKILL.md L86.
- Item 1 (L26–27) holds against the scenario on the card: a 10-hour stop followed by a round that reads only the newest run now reads the whole window, files the anchor even when `main` is green again, and writes the gap. No gate reads these lines; none is claimed.
- **Should-fix 1 — L27 is broader than the rule beside it.** 「窗内无锚红当轮立 p0 锚卡」 anchors any unanchored red in the window p0, queue reds included, while L29 (「flake 锚卡判确定性才升」) and #27047 item 5 (a `queue-flake-anchor` becomes p0 only when triage reads the red as deterministic) grade a flaky queue red lower at first touch. The card's own words (「Any red in that window that has no anchor gets a p0 anchor now」) license L27, and the measured misses were `main` push reds, so this is not a must-fix; but the two lines now disagree inside one file and L27 is the one that hands triage the wider grading power. Bound L27 to 「主干红与确定性队列红」 or to 「照 L29 定级」 in the same bytes.
- **Should-fix 2 — the deleted scope sentence has no home.** Old L3 「本文是分诊座位的全部职责」 was the file's only bound on what triage does; SKILL.md L86 restates who reads the file and when, not that the list is exhaustive. The dev's reason (duties also live in contract-review.md, state-machine.md L40, landing-operations 约定③) is true of `main`, but the cure for an over-claim is a narrower bound, not none: a seat whose remit the maintainer limited (「你只处理分诊」, amended once by #27047 item 6) loses the one line that said so. Fold a pointer into L1 or L15, or into SKILL.md L86's row.
- Item 2 (L60) holds: `pm:epic` cards carrying `pm:retriage` are answered 「即答」, parents still never dispatched; the dropped cloud clause is restated where triage reads before routing (SKILL.md L85 → cross-repo-coordination.md L44). L61–62 still define 「涉 cloud」 for that rule, which now lives one file over — acceptable, noted.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`** — held against card item 3, ruling #27062 items 2–4, and the reader that implements it (`contractReviewHold`, `owedReviewRow`).
- The template on L29 is the card's shape, and the reader pins it verbatim in this file with the 24-hour constant (self-test, `readFileSync` of this path). Four facts split on the doorbell separator; the session uses the claim reader's one regex; the head is 7–40 hex matched by prefix either way; the template copied unedited is unreadable; newest governs through `latestMarkedComment` as the hand-off line does; age from `created_at`, 24 h reads `overdue: true` and still `live`; no stamp reads `overdue: null` and is listed, never dropped. The reader does what L30–31 say.
- Against the card's scenario (#27268: a lane says in prose 「head will move」, triage claims under (b), withdraws): a lane now posts one line; `check-owed-reviews` prints `hold live … holds (b) waited N min` and keeps the row WAIT; (b) cannot fire. Holds.
- **Should-fix 3 — an unreadable newest line voids a readable live hold, and the failure runs in triage's favour.** `contractReviewHold` resolves by `latestMarkedComment`; if the newest comment matching the key is unreadable, the whole reading is `unreadable` and 「holds nothing」, so (b) fires even when an older comment carries a readable hold on the current head. `keyLineRegex` matches a backticked or bulleted key at line start, so a later seat note, round record or review that quotes the template line (as records of this very rule will) is exactly such a comment. `contractReviewClaims` takes the opposite convention (skips unreadable rows, honours every readable claim), and the hand-off reader's same convention fails conservatively (an unreadable newest hand-off means triage does not take). Here the same convention fails toward triage taking. Read the newest *readable* hold on the current head, or let an unreadable newest line keep (b) suppressed and print the gap; the rule text L30 is consistent with either.
- **Should-fix 4 — trigger (c) overrides a live hold, and the rule text does not say so.** The card and L30 name (b) only; the script header and its pins assert 「(a) and (c) still fire」. (c) is 「lane seat stood down or absent」, which every lane meets nightly at 收班. A hold posted 「until the last sibling merges」 before the lane's shift ends is taken by triage at the next round — the churn the card filed to end, now without the lane's objection on record. Either L30 states that (a) and (c) still fire (so a lane knows its hold does not outlive its seat), or the reader lets a live hold suppress (c) as well while its age is under 24 h. Not a must-fix: the card's text names (b) alone and the implementation follows it; the maintainer's call.
- L33, L49, L60 (in-place and fold edits) hold against their restatements (①). No must-fix.

Both files stay at their ceilings; `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-record-recognisers` ran green on the head inside `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`; no line exceeds 120 B that did not already on `main`.
